_why: KNOWFRESH1a-i (D220's KNOWFRESH1a note; docs/2026-10-30-knowledge-freshness-design.md §3.1; .claude/knowledge/twins.md): the mark a decision's note carries, one table its two readers are held to row for row. tools/orient-index.mjs (readMarks) reads it for the gate in `--check`, tools/orient-index.test.mjs holds it here; the service's DecisionNotes.Marks reads it for the knowledge index, and DecisionNotesTests holds it here. A mark is a note whose label, the emphasised span that opens its line, opens `Amended by D<n>` or `Superseded by D<n>`, the rest free; a `, replacing "<label>"` quote, which must be the full text of an earlier note's label and never the digest's cut one, targets that note, and a note with such a quote and no `by D<n>` is the same decision's own amendment (`by self`). Each decision: its file's lines, its heading first and a last empty line for the newline a file ends with; and its marks, one row each, `<id>:<line> <amended|superseded> by <D<n>|self>` with ` replacing <id>:<line>` for the earlier note the quote names or ` replacing none` for a quote that names no note. A parenthetical inside a paragraph, and a label that holds the words later than its opening, read unmarked. The lines are the actual text of D107.md:123, D117.md:131, D84.md:41 and D33.md:53, and the long note is one whose label the digest cuts.

decisions.why: each form a mark takes: bold and italic, a colon and a period, a row or a date or a section after the decision, a label of a task's note, Superseded, undated, a quote of a full label, of a cut one and of an earlier mark, a same-decision amendment, and four notes that are no mark

*(Amended by D70, 2026-09-24: registered is addressable; adopted is not.)* It sits inside a paragraph, so it is no note.
